run_token_stats: run the TokenStats script to compute tokenized length statistics for a ParlAI dataset
run_token_stats_field: run the TokenStats script with a custom field to compute token stats on labels instead of text
run_token_stats_final_only: run the TokenStats script with final-only mode to only count tokens at episode boundaries
review_compute_stats: review the _compute_stats method to understand how min, max, median, and percentile values are calculated
summarize_token_stats: summarize the TokenStats class which iterates over a ParlAI teacher to collect and report token length statistics
